description: This file defines classes and functions related to secure user input messages within the confui namespace, including secure user selection and touch messages, with mechanisms to mark messages as secure or insecure.

classes.name: ConfUiSecureUserSelectionMessage
classes.description: A message class that wraps a user selection message with a security flag indicating if the message is secure.

classes.name: ConfUiSecureUserTouchMessage
classes.description: A message class that wraps a user touch message with a security flag indicating if the message is secure.

methods.name: ConfUiSecureUserSelectionMessage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the secure user selection message with a wrapped message and a security flag.

methods.name: ConfUiSecureUserTouchMessage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the secure user touch message with a wrapped message and a security flag.

methods.name: ToSecureSelectionMessage
methods.description: Function to create a secure user selection message from an existing message and a security flag.

methods.name: ToSecureTouchMessage
methods.description: Function to create a secure user touch message from an existing message and a security flag.
